title: Base64
description: Non-empty binary value in standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4: alphabet A-Z a-z 0-9 + /, '=' padding required, no line breaks, no URL-safe alphabet) in its canonical form: the unused bits before the padding are zero (RFC 4648 section 3.5), so every value has exactly one text, e.g. AA== but not AB==. Used for PIN hash and salt and the device secret.
